en.name: Mexico–China Nearshoring & Manufacturing Forum
en.description: Chinese manufacturers meet Mexican industrial parks, logistics operators, and government development agencies.
en.metaTitle: Mexico–China Nearshoring & Manufacturing Forum | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Chinese manufacturers meet Mexican industrial parks, logistics operators, and government development agencies. Monterrey, 5–6 March 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A forum connecting Chinese manufacturers with Mexican industrial parks, logistics operators, and government development agencies around nearshoring.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Manufacturers, industrial park operators, and government development officials.
en.formatHtml: Site-selection briefings and one-on-one meetings with industrial park operators.

br.metaDescription: Fabricantes chineses encontram parques industriais mexicanos, operadores logisticos e agencias governamentais de desenvolvimento. Em Monterrey, 5–6 de marco de 2026.

cn.name: 墨西哥–中国近岸外包与制造业论坛
cn.description: 中国制造商与墨西哥工业园区、物流运营商及政府发展机构对接。
cn.metaTitle: 墨西哥–中国近岸外包与制造业论坛 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年3月5–6日，蒙特雷，中国制造商与墨西哥工业园区、物流运营商及政府发展机构对接。
cn.overviewHtml: 一场围绕近岸外包主题的论坛，连接中国制造商与墨西哥工业园区、物流运营商及政府发展机构。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 制造商、工业园区运营商，以及政府发展官员。
cn.formatHtml: 包含选址简报以及与工业园区运营商的一对一会谈。
